clips.title: The story
paras: The Hall of Arms is a heavily guarded wing within Tyr's Hand Abbey in southeastern Eastern Plaguelands. It serves as a staging ground and barracks for the martial vanguard of the Scarlet Crusade garrisoned at the stronghold. Positioned across the abbey from the library, it houses some of the crusade's most zealous and well-armored fighters.

Situated to the south of the abbey's main hall, the Hall of Arms functions as an armory and quarters for the militant forces of Tyr's Hand. While the opposing wing holds archives and holy texts, this wing is dedicated purely to the discipline of war. Clad in heavy armor and sworn to eradicate the undead and anyone deemed impure, the Scarlet defenders stationed here maintain a tireless watch over their eastern bastion, keeping weapons sharpened and shields polished against the surrounding horrors of the Plaguelands.
